name: Richmond
summary: Virginia's capital on the James — a Jefferson-designed statehouse, a superb art museum, and the country's most thoughtful Civil War museum.

lodging.name: A hotel in the Fan or downtown Richmond
lodging.blurb: Near Monument Avenue's tree-lined blocks and the museums.

foodMustTry.name: Richmond's celebrated restaurant scene
foodMustTry.blurb: The city punches well above its weight for food.

days.label: Day 151 — The Capitol & the Revolution
days.summary: Where Patrick Henry spoke and Virginia governs.

item.title: Virginia State Capitol
item.blurb: Designed by Thomas Jefferson, modeled on a Roman temple — one of the oldest working capitols in the country.

item.title: St. John's Church
item.blurb: Where Patrick Henry demanded 'Give me liberty, or give me death!' in 1775 (live reenactments in season).

days.label: Day 152 — Civil War & art
days.summary: The war's story, told with care, and a world-class museum.

item.title: American Civil War Museum
item.blurb: At the Tredegar ironworks — the war told from Union, Confederate, and enslaved perspectives, in the former Confederate capital.

item.title: Virginia Museum of Fine Arts

location.name: Virginia Museum of Fine Arts
location.address: 200 N Arthur Ashe Blvd, Richmond, VA

item.blurb: A free, encyclopedic art museum with a renowned Fabergé collection.

commute.scenicNote: Down the peninsula to the Historic Triangle.
